interpretation: These are code-mutation families and initial parameter proposals, not an assertion that every cross-product is supported or faster.

mutations: separate weight cache from prompt-dependent DiT state
families.constraint: No timed-input preprocessing before the timer; existing same-prompt cache is part of baseline, not a new discovery.

families.evidence: At least 2000 MLP tensor allocations and 1000 attention LSE allocations over 50 layers times 20 evaluations.
families.gate: Lifetime, aliasing, peak memory and full trajectory checks.

families.constraint: Workspace and algorithm changes are separate experiments; cache keys include dimensions, dtype, strides, alignment and epilogue.
Existing BF16 GPU sampler is not acceptable; implement the reference FP32 Euler operation order.
Stable pointers, explicit dependencies, complete cross-stream timing and no request-dependent work outside the timer.

mutations: gate/residual then AdaLN in one kernel
families.constraint: Existing Q/K normalization plus RoPE is already fused; do not count it again. Preserve BF16 round points first; every rewrite must pass the full diffusion trajectory.

mutations: CUTLASS GEMM/epilogues when profiles justify it
families.constraint: Original types and FP32 accumulation; no TF32/quantization. Explicitly preserve first-step singleton timestep batching.

mutations: Hopper TMA/WGMMA or BF16 FlashAttention-3 candidate
families.constraint: Only legal resource configurations; no FP8. DiT BF16 head_dim=128 and VAE FP32 head_dim=64 need separate kernels and precision checks.

mutations: overlap copy with later independent tile work
families.constraint: Fixed 256px tile boundaries, overlap and original blending/clamp order; H3's VAE is a Transformer, so changing tile context changes the model computation.
Preserve FP32 math and audio output; report pure decoder execution separately from weight preparation.
A prefetch ring already exists; baseline is threads=8/depth=2. Track host-memory cost and actual overlap.

families.evidence: 15 original spatial tiles times 3 temporal chunks = 45 independent complete tile decodes.
families.constraint: Do not change tile geometry or precision; reassemble outputs in the reference blending order. Include weights, result communication and GPU reservation time.

Validate legal combinations and actual topology. Uneven token shards need exact handling; any padding is masked and cannot affect attention. All-reduce order and online softmax changes must pass full precision checks.

placement: shared pool with concurrent audio/video decode

families.constraint: Text precedes DiT and decoders depend on final latents. Ordinary layer pipeline or data parallelism is not assumed to lower batch-one latency; stale-feature PipeFusion is excluded.
